role: XCTest suite pinning the five ACWRBand acute:chronic ratio bands (edges, order, copy) and that the PDF DeepDiveReportRenderer.interpretACWR text uses the same band label/detail as the Training Load screen.
types: ACWRBandTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase for ACWRBand and PDF ACWR interpretation

units.does: Asserts ACWRBand(ratio:) boundaries: 0.0/0.79→belowUsual, 0.8/1.0→maintenance, 1.01/1.3→inRange, 1.31/1.5→aboveUsual, 1.51/3.0→sharpIncrease (edges inclusive on the upper side).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts ACWRBand.allCases order is [belowUsual, maintenance, inRange, aboveUsual, sharpIncrease].
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts all ACWRBand labels are distinct and every band has non-empty label, detail and rangeText.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: asserts label/detail/rangeText non-empty; loop over 5 fixed cases

units.does: Builds DeepDiveReportRenderer with a PDFReportGenerator over default UserSettings and asserts interpretACWR(ratio) for 0.5/0.9/1.1/1.4/1.8 contains the ACWRBand label and detail for that ratio.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: asserts the PDF text contains band.label and band.detail; one ratio per band

units.does: Asserts interpretACWR(0.9) no longer contains 'Within your usual' and interpretACWR(1.8) no longer contains 'Sharp recent increase' (old four-band PDF wording).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: Asserts absence of English literals while interpretACWR returns String(localized:) via LanguageManager.appBundle; under a non-English app language the assertions pass vacuously.
